description: This Java source file provides assertion utility methods for testing Jsonifiable objects, specifically for comparing their JSON representations based on field selectors and predicates. It contains static methods to assert equality of Jsonifiable objects' JSON outputs filtered by specific conditions, aiding in unit tests.

classes.name: JsonifiableAssertions
classes.description: A utility class providing static assertion methods to compare Jsonifiable objects' JSON representations based on field selectors and predicates for testing purposes.

methods.name: hasEqualJson
methods.description: Asserts that two Jsonifiable objects have equal JSON representations when filtered by a specific JsonFieldSelector and Predicate, considering only the matched fields.

methods.name: hasEqualJson
methods.description: Asserts that two Jsonifiable objects have equal JSON representations when filtered solely by a Predicate, ignoring other fields.
